stories.title: Muere Presley Gerber, hijo de Cindy Crawford, a los 27 años

en.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford, dies at 27
en.summary: The model and brother of Kaia Gerber, who had publicly discussed mental health struggles, died while in rehabilitation.

en.title: What do we hear when we are in a coma?
en.summary: A young woman's account of weeks in unconsciousness provides insights into what coma patients may perceive and challenges fictional portrayals of the condition.

stories.title: En el mundo hay 350 diamantes verdes puros. Esta joyería tiene casi 200

en.title: There are 350 pure green diamonds in the world. This jewelry store has almost 200
en.summary: An Italian jeweler named Garatti has built a brand around extreme exclusivity, possessing nearly 200 of the world's rarest pure green diamonds.

stories.title: Las fuerzas de seguridad de Marruecos blindan la frontera con Ceuta en vísperas de las elecciones

en.title: Moroccan security forces strengthen border with Ceuta ahead of elections
en.summary: Spain's embassy warned Morocco about risks of mass crossings into the autonomous city during Wednesday's elections, according to Moroccan media reports.

stories.title: Un agente del ICE dispara y hiere a un inmigrante venezolano en Texas

en.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds Venezuelan immigrant in Texas
en.summary: An ICE agent fired a shot that wounded a Venezuelan immigrant in Texas. The victim sustained a gunshot wound to the torso and remains in serious but stable condition while in agency custody.

stories.title: Rajada histórica de Mourinho: «Enhorabuena al Comité Arbitral»

en.title: Historic outburst from Mourinho: "Congratulations to the Arbitration Committee"
en.summary: Mourinho criticized referee decisions in a match, presenting photographic evidence of two incidents he deemed clear red cards. He expressed frustration about the impact of playing with numerical disadvantage during the contest.

stories.title: Un agente de ICE dispara en Texas contra un migrante venezolano, que se encuentra en estado "grave"

en.title: ICE agent shoots Venezuelan migrant in Texas in serious condition
en.summary: A 28-year-old Venezuelan man identified as Wilber Garcés was shot by an ICE agent in Texas. He was transported to a local hospital with a gunshot wound to the torso and remains in serious condition.

stories.title: Emoción y aplausos en el pase de 'La bola negra' en el Festival de San Sebastián

en.title: Emotion and applause at 'La bola negra' screening at San Sebastián Film Festival
en.summary: The directors Los Javis presented their film 'La bola negra' at the San Sebastián Film Festival, with cast members including Penélope Cruz walking a red carpet. The audience gave the film a standing ovation at the end of the screening.

stories.title: La CDU del canciller Merz se queda fuera de un Parlamento regional por primera vez en su historia

en.title: Merz's CDU fails to enter regional parliament for first time in its history
en.summary: Chancellor Merz's CDU party fell below the 5% threshold required in the Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania state election for the first time. The far-right AfD won the election while Die Linke will govern in Berlin.

stories.title: Ya está aquí Mourinho: “Quien tiene que estar feliz es el comité de designación arbitral”

en.title: Mourinho is here: "Those who should be happy are the referee appointment committee"
en.summary: Real Madrid's coach criticized the referee, VAR, and those responsible for officiating after a match, claiming two red cards should have been issued against Atlético.

stories.title: 'La bola negra', de Los Javis, gana el premio del público del Festival de Toronto

en.title: 'La bola negra', by Los Javis, wins the audience award at the Toronto Festival
en.summary: The Spanish film 'La bola negra' won the public award at the Toronto Film Festival and has been selected to represent Spain in the Academy Awards.

stories.title: La CDU se estrella y desaparece por primera vez de un parlamento regional de Alemania, según las proyecciones

en.title: The CDU collapses and disappears for the first time from a regional parliament in Germany, according to projections
en.summary: German election projections show the CDU failing to enter a regional parliament for the first time, while left-wing parties won in Berlin and the far-right AfD gained strength in a Baltic state.

en.title: Canada rescues Europe
en.summary: Mark Carney, described as a committed liberal, is positioned as a key figure for European hopes.

stories.title: Diez cuestiones para explicar la crisis de Ceuta

en.title: Ten questions to explain the Ceuta crisis
en.summary: An influx of 80,000 people into Ceuta has triggered an unprecedented border crisis in southern Europe, with Morocco challenging Spain and the European Union through hybrid warfare tactics.

stories.title: De técnico a estratega: las habilidades que disparan su sueldo

en.title: From technician to strategist: the skills that boost your salary
en.summary: Professionals with identical training can earn vastly different salaries. Career advancement and higher compensation require moving from technical execution to leadership roles managing people, projects, and budgets rather than accumulating technical expertise.

stories.title: Pierre Fabre elige España como país piloto para el lanzamiento internacional de Même

en.title: Pierre Fabre chooses Spain as pilot country for international launch of Même
en.summary: Pierre Fabre has selected Spain as its pilot market for the international expansion of Même, a cosmetics brand for cancer patients and sensitive skin, which will be distributed through Spanish pharmacies and El Corte Inglés.

stories.title: Economía se lanza a cambiar dos leyes para apuntalar el escudo anti-opas extranjeras

en.title: Economy ministry launches effort to change two laws to strengthen foreign takeover shield
en.summary: The Spanish Government seeks to make permanent its protections against EU investors and will require prior authorization for construction of data centers and energy facilities.
